diagnosis: A fixed assistant load error was returned by the scoped sender and its timer entered Attention. The exact error was absent from the delivery record used by later read-only status.

exercised: Existing scoped sender commits and rereads the attributable error from disposable state
Existing replay guard refuses an already sent event
Untrusted or completion-frame diagnostics are refused
Read-only status reopens the exact stored timer and receipt and leaves their bytes intact
Conflicting timer generation withholds receipt and error
A completed timer retains the older failure alongside its current state
